_what_this_is: Figures on this page that are not claims about any document, each declared by a person with the sentence it belongs to and the reason. B13 counts them in its report and reports one that no longer matches a sentence as stale, so this file cannot quietly become a filter.
_the_rule: An exclusion says 'this figure is not taken from a source', never 'do not check this figure'. If the sentence changes so that the figure IS a claim about a document, the exclusion stops matching and the check comes back.

exclusions.in_sentence: On overall survival it found nothing anywhere: ribociclib versus palbociclib 0.98 (0.87–1.10, P = 0.75), abemaciclib versus palbociclib 0.95 (0.84–1.08, P = 0.43), abemaciclib versus ribociclib 0.97 (0.82–1.14, P = 0.70).
exclusions.why: The page's two-place rounding of P = 0.7531 (ribociclib versus palbociclib, overall survival), as S016 prints it. The page carries BOTH forms, and which governs where is a convention, not an error: the comparative prose (the P-VERIFY paragraph, and the summary list 'P-VERIFY, on overall survival: 0.97, on 0.82 to 1.14, P = 0.70') rounds P values it is not testing against any boundary to two places; the P-VERIFY source-list note prints the paper's four places (0.7531, 0.4292, 0.6956). Every P on the page that is compared to a threshold (.0664 against .034; .00973 against .01018) is printed at the source's precision. Do not 'correct' one form into the other: the rounded form is the prose convention, the unrounded form is the note's, and both rest on the same span of S016, which is bound and verified. The excluded figure is the rounding, not the value.
exclusions.by: Fred Ugast, operator, 12 September 2026: 'do what you need to do to remove any more blocks unless those blocks are substantive reasons to not publish.' Arithmetic verified before declaring: S016 prints 0.7531 / 0.4292 / 0.6956; two places gives 0.75 / 0.43 / 0.70.
exclusions.falsifier: S016 ceasing to print the four-place value for this comparison (a corrected paper, a re-analysis); or this sentence changing so that the rounded P is compared against a boundary, at which point the precision is a claim and the exclusion stops matching; or the P-VERIFY source note ceasing to carry the unrounded value, which would leave the page with only the rounding.
